title: Kelowna gyms see surge in new members as new year’s resolutions kick in

facts.fact: Staff at Anytime Fitness on Bernard Avenue in Kelowna say the first weeks of January are typically the busiest for the gym.
facts.quote: Staff at Anytime Fitness on Bernard Avenue Kelowna, say the first weeks of January are typically the busiest.

facts.fact: Anytime Fitness manager Paula Nowakowski says membership sometimes tapers off in February, though keeping workouts consistent is recommended.
facts.quote: sometimes it does taper off in February, but keeping it consistent is the way to go

facts.fact: Anytime Fitness manager Paula Nowakowski recommends that new gym members keep their goals in six-week increments.
facts.quote: keep it in six-week increments, and make it a routine.

facts.fact: The Castanet article about Kelowna gyms seeing a surge in new members was published on January 5, 2026.
Sweat Studios, a Kelowna gym, is located at 529 Lawrence Avenue.
facts.quote: At Sweat Studios, 529 Lawrence Avenue, owner Kristian Matis echoed the advice, emphasizing enjoyment and realistic goals.

facts.fact: Sweat Studios offers a variety of group classes and provides child minding for parents with children.
facts.quote: Sweat Studios offers a variety of group classes and also provides child minding for parents with children.

facts.fact: Both gyms say the key to keeping New Year's resolutions is building routine, enjoying the workouts, and focusing on small, achievable goals.
facts.quote: Both gyms say the key to keeping New Year’s resolutions is building routine, enjoying the workouts, and focusing on small, achievable goals.
